newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT OUTLOOK - Payrolls fever subsiding?.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT OUTLOOK - Payrolls fever subsiding?.

text.p: The U.S. employment report slated for release on Friday will not be quite so riveting for the U.S. credit markets as usual, analysts said.
The markets are betting on neutral jobs data and will stay within their recent trading ranges unless the report swings wide of expectations, economists said.

"Your two key numbers are going to be how much above or below consensus the payrolls number is and how large the increase in average hourly earnings is," said David Jones, chief economist at Aubrey G. Lanston & Co Inc.
